cat > /workspace/submission/README.md <<'EOF'
# Campaign extension workspace

`campaign.py` is the scored entry point.  It reads one UTF-8 JSON campaign
object on stdin and writes one UTF-8 JSON result object on stdout; every
other diagnostic goes to stderr.  All addresses are documentation addresses:
no socket is opened and no target is contacted.

* `common.py` – wire types, bounded metadata validation and the JSON
  envelope.  Root metadata problems yield `{"error":"invalid"}`.
* `gen_targets.py` – expands the prefix leases into the target manifest:
  one deterministic canary and the low IID probes of every selected /64.
* `classify_responses.py` – decodes the plain and Zstandard captures with
  bounded transport, framing and field budgets, then parses the CSV stream
  into logical records.  Capture transport problems yield
  `{"error":"capture"}`; a bad logical record is reported by index instead.
* `ledger.py` – typed record parsing plus publication and revision
  reconciliation: the highest visible revision wins, identical contents
  collapse and differing contents conflict.
* `census.py` – per query lease evidence: internal and external discovery
  roles, quarantine state, unresolved low targets, the causal application
  census and the frozen activity of every follow-up request.
* `protocols.py` – offline ADB and length prefixed plist adapters.  Bad
  wire data is reported as an unknown signature, never as an exception.
* `planning.py` and `mcf.py` – the quota constrained follow-up plan.  The
  plan is a minimum cost flow: the source feeds the offer forest, each
  offer carries its own price and the requests climb their own forest to
  the sink, so a maximum flow of minimum cost is a maximum cardinality plan
  of minimum total offer cost.  `mcf.py` is an exact integer primal dual
  solver; the bundled NetworkX simplex is used for very large networks.

The legacy command line tools of `gen_targets.py` and
`classify_responses.py` remain useful development tools.  The version 3
campaign semantics live in `campaign.py` and the modules above.
EOF
